item.title: Bill granting 'extraordinary powers' to speed up development passes parliament
item.description: A new critical minerals bill aimed at stimulating investment has passed Queensland parliament, with amendments calming some farmers but other critics remain concerned. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Liam McNally and Aimee Mitchell

item.title: NSW couple confirmed missing in deadly Nepal floods
item.description: The ABC has confirmed the identity of a NSW couple who are among a tour group including 15 Australians currently missing in Nepal after catastrophic flash flooding. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Ethan Rix, Jade Toomey, and Stephanie Richards

item.title: A GST deal and the NDIS blew out by billions — but one is sacred
item.description: The Albanese government had a turbulent week with tussles over data centres and division within the Labor party over its humanitarian intake. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jake Evans

item.title: Why a brand new $232 million prison unit has sat unused for a decade
item.description: The minimum-security wing at a $232 million prison in regional WA has never been used, despite union claims that prisoners are sleeping on the floor in other parts of the facility. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jarrod Lucas

item.title: Queensland government introduces major overhaul of bail laws
item.description: Under the bill, offenders who commit a serious crime while on bail will face the prospect of a mandatory minimum 12 months in jail. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Laura Lavelle

item.title: The numbers behind Carlton's transition from AFLW darling to contender
item.description: After a breakout AFLW season last year, Carlton is using some subtle tweaks to take the difficult next step of challenging for the premiership. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: 'Backyard' e-bike battery repairs starting deadly fires, inquest told
item.description: Do-it-yourself and YouTube-inspired lithium-ion battery modifications and repairs have been blamed for fires, some of which were deadly. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Giselle Wakatama

item.title: Young Perth hackers allegedly 'masterminded' global cybercrime syndicate
item.description: Two young Western Australians are described as the alleged "masterminds" behind a "sophisticated cybercrime syndicate" that created malicious software to rob hundreds of organisations around the world. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Callum Liddelow and David Weber

item.title: E-scooter crash leaves teenage boy in critical condition
item.description: A 13-year-old Queensland boy is being treated for life-threatening injuries after crashing an e-scooter in Childers. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Nikki Sorbello and Johanna Marie

item.title: Parents worry kids will inherit climate impact of coal mine extension
item.description: More than 1,500 jobs hang in the balance as the NSW Independent Planning Commission considers extending the life of a Hunter Valley coal mine by 19 years, but some say climate concerns should be the focus. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Yeandle and Amelia Bernasconi

item.title: Pilot's family mourn 'great loss' as police continue search for plane wreckage
item.description: Search and rescue teams are continuing to look for Tasmanian pilot Bob Bramley's plane, after it crashed into remote waters off the NT coast on Tuesday. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Olivana Lathouris and Clancy Balen

item.title: Prime minister intervenes to guarantee refugee intake will not be cut
item.description: The Albanese government's plans to slash more than 6,000 places from its annual refugee intake have sparked anger and confusion within Labor, and prompted accusations it would amount to an "extraordinary betrayal" of the party's rank and file members. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jane Norman

item.title: Thirty-four Australians missing in Nepal flash floods: PM Albanese
item.description: At this point, Nepal is a developing country; it doesn't have the resources that an event like that would have in Australia, so information is difficult, says Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.title: News live: dozens of Australians believed to be among hundreds missing in Nepal flash floods
item.description: Powerful floods in Himalayan border area sweep away houses, roads and bridges. Follow today’s news live Nepal flash flood disaster – live updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The prime minister, Anthony Albanese , says Dfat officials are ready to provide consular assistance to Australians in Nepal, after the devastating flooding in the country. A local tourism official said they believed 34 Australians were missing in the area, among hundreds of foreign nationals. Australian officials were not confirming numbers at this stage, and were working to check on the… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Nick Visser

item.title: Homicide investigation launched after woman dies in Perth's south-east
item.description: A 38-year-old man is taken into custody after the death of a 28-year-old woman found critically injured at a house in the suburb of St James. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: AIS pays more than $3m in restoration to abused athletes
item.description: The Australian Institute of Sport pays out more than 225 athletes who were victims of abuse while holding scholarships between 1981 and 2013. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Electrician school closure leaves more than 80 apprentices in limbo
item.description: Small businesses in central Queensland say they are fed up as their apprentices are left with almost nowhere to train. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jacob Gamble

item.title: Infantino set to receive World Cup win but loses Italy's support
item.description: The pressure on the embattled FIFA president remains immense but he receives a major boost from one of his most vocal opponents. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Starc hits top of ICC's Test bowling rankings for first time
item.description: Mitchell Starc's run of hot form is rewarded handsomely after a dominant Test series against Bangladesh. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Residents furious at illegal dumping in native bushland near school
item.description: Rubbish containing dangerous waste found illegally dumped in bushland upsets Albany residents, with the mayor saying it is the worst he has seen. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Chounding

item.title: He's been a soldier and an ambo, but Allan says teaching nearly broke him
item.description: Teachers are demanding change as the number of reported classroom incidents of violence and aggression surges from 776 to 20,833 in four years. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Elly Bradfield and Grace Nakamura

item.title: Border town lawyer labels Victoria's bird flu handling a 'scandal'
item.description: What determines if suspected bird flu victims are collected or left on the shore? Near the Victorian-SA border, it comes down to roughly three kilometres. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jean Bell

item.title: Live: Qantas profit drops 13 per cent, CBA flips on interest rate predictions
item.description: The Australian share market is set to open slightly lower in morning trading as Qantas releases yearly results. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Adelaide Miller

item.title: Perth prepares for 'one in 10 million' AUKUS nuclear disaster
item.description: People could be given iodine tablets or potentially evacuated in the "extremely low" likelihood of a radiation leak from the reactor core of an AUKUS nuclear submarine, a new plan reveals. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Nicolas Perpitch

item.title: Dozens of Australians believed to be among hundreds of people missing in Nepal flash floods
item.description: Dfat minister Matt Thistlethwaite says staff are liaising with Kathmandu to find 35 missing Australians, and plans to send emergency team to the region Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The Australian government is urgently seeking information on the welfare of at least 35 Australians missing in Nepal, after a catastrophic flash flood swept through the Nepal-Tibet border region. Assistant minister for foreign affairs, Matt Thistlethwaite, said on Thursday evening that the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (Dfat) was “working around the clock” to verify the… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Guardian staff

item.title: 'Absolutely horrible': Sleepless nights for families near new Sydney airport
item.description: Locals living near the new Western Sydney airport say they are only managing a few hours' sleep a night since operations began. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Nabil Al-Nashar

item.title: Thredbo 'exposed to a warming climate' as value cut by $149m
item.description: One of Australia's largest ski resorts has had its value halved, with its owner blaming a poor 2026 snow season and the need to install new chairlifts and more snowmaking. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Mikayla McGuirk-Scolaro and Toby Hemmings

item.title: Live: Queensland premier hails data centre carve-out for coal, gas use
item.description: David Crisafulli welcomes an agreement to exempt his state from having to use renewable energy to power new data centres. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Joshua Boscaini

item.title: Australia's lizards and snakes disappearing faster than previously thought
item.description: Australia's lizards and snakes are facing a far more precarious future than previously understood, with a new review led by Monash University researchers revealing that around 127 species, or just over 13% of Australia's terrestrial lizards and snakes, are now likely to be threatened with extinction—almost double previous estimates. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Police investigating 16yo Sydney girl's death as possible sexual choking act
item.description: Police are continuing to investigate the death of a 16-year-old Sydney girl, which the ABC understands is being treated as a suspected sexual choking act. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jean Kennedy

item.title: Terminally ill Territorians could soon have the right to dying legally
item.description: Voluntary assisted dying laws are expected to pass the Northern Territory Parliament today, in a move that will legalise the practice across Australia. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Gemma Ferguson

item.title: Reduced fertiliser use linked to cleaner water flowing to Great Barrier Reef
item.description: Separate studies claim to show a connection between improved water quality in catchments along Queensland's Great Barrier Reef and farmers changing the way they fertilise their crops. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Sophie Johnson and Brendan Mounter

item.title: Police and KPMG unable to say why $6m contract cancelled
item.description: Tasmania Police officers have been using a 'clunky' intelligence system for years. KPMG was engaged to update it, but after two years and $6 million, its contract has been terminated and neither party can say why. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Adam Holmes

item.title: Research aims to make radiation better at killing cancer cells
item.description: An Adelaide research project is investigating ways to treat brain cancer while having minimal impact on healthy tissue and the human immune system. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Natarsha Kallios

item.title: Teaching watchdog suspends 'bohemian' Melbourne schoolteacher
item.description: The Victorian teaching watchdog has suspended Fitzroy Community School co-founder Faye Berryman's teaching registration on an interim basis following concerns raised by parents and former students. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Josie Taylor and Coco Veldkamp

item.title: Live: Hundreds missing, including 34 Australians, in deadly Himalayan flash floods
item.description: Grave fears are held for hundreds of people missing after flash floods swept through mountainous parts of Nepal and Tibet. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has confirmed 34 Australians are among those unaccounted for. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Thorpe
